text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Increased 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1 (green). Alert ID: A-1759123456
oncall-bot: Paging oncall: @erin (primary) and @vikram (release lead)
erin: picking this up, oncall-ack
erin: looking at traces — tail-error shows spikes from green instances in eu-west, but ap-northeast shows mixed 502/timeout patterns
erin: quick question — did we change routing policy or DNS weights during the green flip?
vikram: yes, we pushed the blue->green for eu-west and then a cross-region weight rebalance to shift ~20% to ap-northeast green for latency tests ~15m ago
vikram: I pushed the release canary and then updated routing flag traffic_routing.region_weights to include ap-northeast:0.2
maria: customer-ops reporting increased 502s from EU customers (prod-eu). Severity: S2 but rising.
customer-ops: several paying customers seeing request failures on monthly-batch jobs; some started failing ~10:05 UTC
erin: running quick curl from EU probe:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api-eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\x0acontent-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream_error"}
```
erin: logs show 502s coming from our green backend returning 502 on kv-get for model cache keys
vikram: that suggests a cold-KV or model mismatch on green instances in ap-northeast -> cross-region cache invalidation bug? we didn't change model binary though
maria: checking recent config pushes — load-balancer health-checks show green fleet passing, but backend app logs show repeated grpc status UNAVAILABLE to kv-store cluster eu-kv-1
dave: I see elevated egress errors from green pods to eu-kv-1; ap-northeast machines are routing to eu-kv via proxy and some routes got stale after we flipped geo weights
erin: impact assessment: ~6% of overall requests in eu-west and ~12% in ap-northeast for last 5m; approx 40 customers had >5% error rate
vikram: initiating emergency rollback of the region-weight for ap-northeast -> 0.0 and reducing eu-west green weight to 0.0, fallback to blue. Will flip feature flag traffic_routing.force_fallback=true
erin: do it, but we need kill-switch steps and an audit. Please paste the API call you will run
vikram: running:
```
# flip the internal routing flag to force fallback to blue
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>' \
  https://config.redwood.internal/flags/traffic_routing/override 
  -d '{"force_fallback": true, "reason": "emergency 502s eu/apac"}'
```
vikram: executed at 2025-06-12T10:12:07Z
oncall-bot: Flag change detected: traffic_routing.override set by vikram (reason: emergency 502s eu/apac).
erin: confirm LB weights are now pointing to blue?
dave: LB weights updated: eu-west -> blue 100%, ap-northeast -> blue 100% (propagation started).
maria: flipping kill switch for proxy route-level fallback as well (proxy.failover.enable=true)

# short pause while TTLs and routes propagate
erin: after flip: errors dropping in eu-west to baseline, ap-northeast still ~3% 502s likely due to DNS TTL and stale sessions
ervin: (typo) sorry
erin: we should also purge edge caches for critical customers and request CDN to purge /v1/generate for eu endpoints
customer-ops: contacting top-5 impacted customers to notify mitigation; they want ETA for full recovery
vikram: ETA 7-10 minutes to get clean routes and for kv-connections to re-establish to blue fleet, then we'll run smoke tests

# Handoff
erin: I'm going to hand off to @dave for follow-up while I jump to next paging rotation. dave will own post-rollback verification and RCA coordination.
dave: taking over — I have the runbook for blue/green rollback. I'll validate with smoke:
```
# smoke test (from eu probe)
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api-eu.redwood.ai/v1/health; done
```
dave: smoke codes all 200s now from EU probe
maria: monitoring panels show 5xx back to baseline, tail error rate cleared. Marking incident as mitigated at 2025-06-12T10:20:10Z

# post-incident notes
erin: summary: bad cross-region weight rebalance + proxy route staleness caused green backends to talk to stale kv proxies; rollback + flag kill-switch restored service. Customer impact: degraded for ~15m, ~40 customers had transient errors, no data loss, some batch jobs retried automatically
vikram: action items: 1) add preflight for geo-kv routing when rebalancing (check proxy route consistency) 2) add quick abort button that flips traffic_routing.force_fallback at infra-api level 3) reduce DNS TTL for rollout windows and document in runbook
dave: I'll own RCA doc and timeline. Tagging @sre-bot to create incident ticket and schedule postmortem.
sre-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2025-1759123456. Postmortem scheduled for 2025-06-13 15:00 UTC.
erin: nice work everyone. please add any customer messages to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
customer-ops: we'll follow up with affected customers with timeline and root cause summary.
vikram: will prepare a short engineer-facing summary and the flag-change audit log.
end of thread
